notes: Each value is the year-over-year revenue growth percentage NVIDIA states verbatim in its own press-release opening bullets (e.g. Q2 FY2027: 'Revenue of $96.2 billion, up 106% from a year ago'). This is actual reported quarterly growth, not the forward-looking 70% fiscal-2028 guide or the 140% customer-forecast figure from the Q2 FY2027 earnings call -- those two numbers are guidance/commentary, not a published historical series, so they are not included as points here. The chart's usefulness is contextual: it shows growth already decelerating quarter over quarter even before the 70% FY2028 guide takes hold (56% -> 62% -> 73% -> 85% -> 106%; note the trend is still accelerating as of the most recent quarter, which is part of why the CFO's memory-supply-constrained 70% guide reads as a sharp deceleration from recent trend, let alone the 140% customer ask).
